OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

VERSION().details: It remains 1 for the compatibility with the previous version.

createTracker(uint256,uint256).details: Creates a new Tracker and populate initial values from AddressBook Only allowed to the contract owner.

isCnStakingV2(address).details: Test if the given contract is a CnStakingV2 instance Does not check if the contract is registered in AddressBook.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

readCnStaking(address).details: Read various fields from a CnStaking contract

refreshStake(address).details: Re-evaluate Tracker contents related to the staking contract Anyone can call this function, but `staking` must be a staking contract registered in tracker.

refreshVoter(address).details: Re-evaluate voter account mapping related to the staking contract Anyone can call this function, but `staking` must be a staking contract registered to the current AddressBook. Updates the voter account of the GC of the `staking` with respect to the current AddressBook. If the GC already had a voter account, the account will be unregistered. If the new voter account is already appointed for another GC, this function reverts.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.
